changelog: Queue and API consistency: a cancel has to name what it stops instead of stopping every run on the server, a cache clear refuses while a run is reading the cache, a bitmap subtitle is listed with the reason it cannot be synced, and re-syncing the plugin's own sidecar updates it instead of nesting a second marker into the library
description: Synchronize subtitles with video audio using ffsubsync
name: SubSync
overview: Adds a Sync Subtitles action to any video, using ffsubsync as backend
